title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Sunday, 13 September 2026
description: Today: OpenAI launches its GPT-Live voice model and a new cross-industry AI-agent trust framework debuts; Australia's Parliament tackles superannuation and NDIS reform; Queensland investigates coalmine contraband and a new bee mite detection; and a 1995 Gold Coast cold case reopens. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
